name: Send Weekly Analytics Comparison to Email and Telegram

nodes.name: Google Analytics: Past 7 days of the previous year

values.content:
=Please analyze the following data and output the results in tabular form:

| Metrics | Last 7 days | Previous year | Percentage change |
|-------------------------------|---------------|---------|
| Total page views | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.sum_Aufrufe }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.sum_Aufrufe }} | Percentage change |
| total users | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.sum_Nutzer }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.sum_Nutzer }} | Percentage change |
| Total sessions | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.sum_Sitzungen }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.sum_Sitzungen }} | Percentage change |
| Average sessions/user | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.average_Sitzungen_pro_Nutzer }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.average_Sitzungen_pro_Nutzer }} | Percentage change |
| Average session duration | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.average_Sitzungsdauer }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.average_Sitzungsdauer }} | Percentage change |
| Total purchases | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json['sum_Käufe'] }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json['sum_Käufe'] }} | Percentage change |
| Average revenue/purchase | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.average_Revenue_pro_Kauf }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.average_Revenue_pro_Kauf }} | Percentage change |
| Total revenue | {{ $('Summarize Data').item.json.sum_Revenue }} | {{ $('Summarize Data1').item.json.sum_Revenue }} | Percentage change |

Format for numbers:
- Dot (.) for numbers in thousands (e.g. 4,000)
- Comma (,) for decimal numbers (e.g. 3.4)
- Conversion of average session duration in minutes instead of seconds
- Average turnover/purchase and total turnover in the property reporting currency, without adding a currency symbol

Please write a short summary of the analyzed data above the table (in a maximum of 3 sentences!)

Please format to a sleek and modern HTML format so that the result can be sent as HTML mail!

Structure of the e-mail:

“Hello! Here is the Weekly Report: Google Analytics of the last 7 days!
[Summary]
[Table]”
